items.description: Disposal of shed roof timber and broken glass
items.rationale: Remains of insured shed are material arising under 5.2.1(a); both elements indemnifiable so combined position OK. Reference case 8 prices (glass ~32, timber <75).

items.description: Combined load: green waste, root mass >1 m3, soil
items.rationale: Root mass over 1 m3 and soil are excluded from 5.2.1 (d),(e); no reinstatement making good ground under 5.2.2, so the combined position fails under 7.1.10.
Ground material excluded under 5.2.1(d); standalone clearance without making good not covered by 5.2.2.
Ground material excluded under 5.2.1(d) and 5.2.2; reference case 8 t=0.
